name_zh: 新加坡·吴作栋：接班开放自由与精英转型
name_en: Singapore Goh Chok Tong: Succession Opening Freedom & Elite Transformation
description_zh: 吴作栋 (1941-) 新加坡第二任总理 (1990-2004)，在李光耀阴影下平稳接班，开放言论艺术文化，应对1997亚洲金融风暴与2003萨斯，推动滨海湾金沙圣淘沙综合度假村经济转型。
description_en: Goh Chok Tong (1941-) Singapore second PM (1990-2004), smooth succession under Lee Kuan Yew shadow, opened speech arts culture, responded 1997 Asian financial crisis and 2003 SARS, drove Marina Bay Sands Sentosa integrated resorts economic transformation.
reason_zh: 吴作栋代表权力平稳交接如何在强人阴影下实现软着陆，展示了开放自由如何作为社会释压阀与经济动力双重功能，其危机管理与转型治理为继任者铺路。
reason_en: Goh Chok Tong represents how peaceful power transition achieves soft landing under strongman shadow, demonstrating how opening freedom serves both social pressure valve and economic driver dual function, his crisis management and transformation governance paved way for successor.
steps_zh: 研究吴作栋早年海军经济规划署与李光耀钦点接班
分析1990年接班温和协商风格与李光耀资政部长制衡
探讨1997亚洲金融风暴新加坡避险港与货币稳定
评估2003萨斯透明隔离追踪与综合度假村经济转型
总结接班开放自由转型对新加坡代际治理的平稳传承
steps_en: Study Goh Chok Tong early navy economic planning and Lee Kuan Yew handpicked succession
Analyze 1990 succession moderate consultative style and Lee Kuan Yew Senior Minister check
Explore 1997 Asian financial crisis Singapore safe haven and currency stability
Evaluate 2003 SARS transparent isolation tracing and integrated resorts economic transformation
Summarize succession opening freedom transformation smooth intergenerational governance transmission
expected_zh: 理解强人阴影下接班者如何通过开放释压实现软着陆，掌握危机管理与经济转型双轮驱动代际传承逻辑，评估吴作栋为李显龙时代铺设的制度轨道。
expected_en: Understand how successor under strongman shadow achieves soft landing through opening pressure release, grasp crisis management and economic transformation dual wheel driving intergenerational transmission logic, evaluate Goh Chok Tong institutional track laid for Lee Hsien Loong era.
case_zh: 1941 出生；1990 总理；1997 风暴；2003 萨斯；2004 卸任。接班开放自由转型范式永存。
case_en: 1941 birth; 1990 PM; 1997 crisis; 2003 SARS; 2004 retirement. Succession opening freedom transformation paradigm endures.
cross_cultural_impact: Peaceful succession; crisis management; economic transformation; intergenerational governance
